facts.text: Andrew usually tries to escape the city at least once a weekend for hiking.

evidence.quote: So I usually try to escape the city at least once a weekend - it's my much-needed break!

facts.text: Andrew finds hiking in nature to be therapeutic and describes it as peaceful and invigorating.

evidence.quote: Nature is so therapeutic for me. It's hard to put into words how great it feels to be surrounded by greenery or standing on top of a mountain breathing in the fresh air. So peaceful and invigorating.

facts.text: Audrey recently went on a hike and had an experience with a hummingbird.

evidence.quote: Last week I finally went on a hike and had this amazing experience with a hummingbird.

facts.text: Andrew shared a photo of a view of a lake and mountains at sunset, which he described as refreshing.

evidence.quote: Remember I was feeling down because I couldn't get out more? Well, good news - I found a new open space to hike nearby - feels so refreshing!
I try to capture those special moments and share that feeling with others.
